purpose: Test one predeclared voxel-conditional affine Gaussianization intervention after V20 marginal Gaussianization failed Q3/Q4.

v21_conditional_affine.feature: frozen V14 conditional_mean field m in y units

profile.edges: equal-source pooled training voxel quantiles q=0,.1,...,1; source weight 1/3
profile.center: equal-source weighted mean m in each bin
profile.mu: mean of three source bin means
profile.interpolation: piecewise-linear float64 at frozen bin centers; constant extrapolation
profile.application: profile evaluated from m, then cast to float32

transform.r_definition: V14 standardized residual before V21 affine
transform.recipe: V20 equal-source weighted histogram midpoint CDF, Addendum A monotonic repair
transform.cube_centering: subtract each cube mean of G21(u) before inherited Addendum-B projection
transform.inverse: r=u*sigma(m)+mu(m) after G21 inverse and sampler DC centering

new_gate_diagnostics.Q3: V20 Q3 thresholds unchanged; evaluate per deterministic-mean voxel decile and domain
new_gate_diagnostics.Q4: V20 Q4 threshold unchanged; evaluate per deterministic-mean voxel decile and domain
new_gate_diagnostics.Q5: all inherited no-harm checks unchanged; selection_role none

Q6.name: conditional_profile_match
Q6.statistics: per-domain equal-source residual mean/std and generated-minus-truth delta

hard_preflight: validate this registry and all parent/audit hashes without opening Astrid or historical EAGLE
fit profile and G21 from train caches only and reproduce frozen bytes and moments
audit six new caches with inherited Addendum-B exact float32 zero-DC projection
remeasure sigma_data and band variances from final V21 cache bytes; derive p_mean=ln(0.6*sigma_data)
prove conditional inverse consumes no random numbers and preserve draw-paired initialization
run full tests and independent implementation audit before GPU execution
confirm clean committed worktree and Lageunha Ada allocation
fixed_decision_order: freeze registry, implement, and independently audit V21
train from scratch on Lageunha Ada; evaluate 5000 then 10000
if Q3/Q4/Q5 pass in all three domains, select smallest passing step and stop before seal
otherwise classify failure by Q3/Q4 and stop with Astrid unopened
never tune profile bins, floor, transform, architecture, loss, sampler, seeds, subsets, or thresholds after results
